topic: Linear-light radiance alpha blending versus gamma-encoded sRGB direct mixing
topic_zh: 线性辐射度空间混合与 sRGB 编码值直混发黑对比
scope: Deterministic IEC 61966-2-1 EOTF/OETF transfer functions, relative luminance conservation Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B, and 4096-entry LUT vs per-sample Math.pow CPU solving. No HDR-GS CUDA kernel execution.

protocol.function: IEC 61966-2-1 EOTF decode → L = (1-α)L_A + αL_B → OETF encode → 100% luminance conserved (#BCBCBC)

robustness.name: Sampled alpha checkpoints retain 100% physical photon luminance

good_fit: Eliminating dark muddy troughs in complementary cross-fades and particle trails
3D Gaussian Splatting and volumetric alpha compositing in linear radiance
Explaining why #FF0000 + #00FFFF at α=0.50 must be #BCBCBC (0.735) instead of #808080 (0.500)
Fast CPU/GPU palette interpolation via pre-decoded linear endpoints and OETF LUTs
not_for: HDR-GS dual differentiable CUDA rasterization or GaussHDR neural tone mapping
Perceptual hue-wheel palette design where Oklab / Oklch chroma preservation is preferred
Un-dithered 8-bit linear framebuffers without sRGB hardware write conversion
